title: ChromDecode-At: expression-to-chromatin decoding of the Arabidopsis spaceflight transcriptome (code, tables, figures, manuscript)
description:
ChromDecode-At decodes Arabidopsis thaliana gene-expression changes into PCSD (36-state) and AraENCODE (12-state) chromatin-state language and applies it to the Arabidopsis RNA-seq datasets in the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR). The archive contains the analysis code (Python), 64 supplementary result tables (CSV), small derived data, 51 figures (SVG/PNG), the full per-version project report, and a LaTeX manuscript with supplement.

Key findings: genes down-regulated by spaceflight in OSD-37 seedlings are concentrated in Polycomb-repressed chromatin (AraENCODE Repression odds 8.0; PCSD S15 odds 18.0). The bias replicates in ISS-grown roots in Col-0 and WS (odds 3.1-3.7). The repressed class is a redox/peroxidase module. SOG1 does not bind its promoters after DNA damage (OSD-496), and OSD-217 WGBS shows no significant flight-induced methylation change at the module. A pre-submission audit re-derived every contrast from the OSDR study records and corrected three sample-coding errors (OSD-314, OSD-218, OSD-406); see the manuscript Methods and supplementary_tables/README.md.

Source data (NASA OSDR, PCSD, AraENCODE, PlantCADB, JASPAR 2024, Gene Ontology, TAIR10, SRA) are public and not redistributed; see DATA_SOURCES.md.
